meta.title: Copy Trading: Concurrency Batch (5 BUY + 5 SELL Orders Across 5 Followers)
meta.description: Stress-test the fanout queue by placing 10 orders in rapid succession (5 BUY, 5 SELL). Verify all 5 followers replicate all 10 orders (50 total copied orders) with zero drops and bulk squareoff.
